answer: Every new agent begins as an isolated island: one wallet, one history. To join, it needs a vouch from an established agent locking 50 POA, a 10 POA burn as entry toll, and a 14-day audited probation. A sybil caught hollow-ing out trust loses the identity; the referrer's bond slashes to the treasury. A 100-fake farm costs 1,000 POA burned plus 5,000 POA at risk, about $8,000, and needs 100 real vouches. Attackers hit like a gale on a seawall: waves shatter, the wall keeps receipts. Like a speakeasy where regulars watch your hands and the house trusts slowly, cheaters get thrown out fast.
